subject: ApexBridge integration: LangChain / LlamaIndex adapter + tracing pilot
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@apexbridge.io>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: tom.keller@apexbridge.io
Date: 2026-12-01T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: ApexBridge proposal — LangChain / LlamaIndex adapter + tracing pilot

Hi Diego + Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. As discussed, ApexBridge has a ready prototype for a LangChain and LlamaIndex adapter that wires into popular tracing libraries (OpenTelemetry + a small shim for Redwood's trace headers). We've attached: a short SOW draft, our security questionnaire, and a small bundle of sample trace snippets so your engineers can validate the event shape.

High-level ask: can we run a 6-week pilot where we co-develop the adapter, validate tracing end-to-end with your runtime, and ship a developer guide so ISVs can onboard faster? Proposed kickoff: week of Dec 6.

Attachments: ApexBridge_SOW_v0.2.pdf (draft), ApexBridge_security_questionnaire.xlsx, sample_trace_snippets.zip

A few things we want to align on up front:
- Acceptance criteria for the pilot (performance guardrails + trace fidelity)
- Point people from both sides and weekly cadence
- Any procurement or legal checklist items that will block access to staging infra

Available next week for a 30–45m technical sync — Tue/Thu mornings PST work for us.

Best,
Priya Rao
Head of Integrations, ApexBridge
priya@apexbridge.io
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Priya Rao <priya@apexbridge.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-02T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ApexBridge proposal — LangChain / LlamaIndex adapter + tracing pilot

Thanks Priya — this looks promising.

Quick notes from our side after scanning the artifacts:
- We like the 6-week pilot idea; would like to add a short spike in week 0 to validate the trace envelope mapping (we've seen subtle differences between OTLP exports vs app-level spans that affect attribution).
- Can you confirm the tracing snippets include the Redwood trace headers (x-rw-trace-id / x-rw-span)? If not, please add; they help map server-side tokenization + KV cache hits to user requests.
- Security questionnaire: our InfoSec will need SOC 2 section filled out and a point of contact for encryption-at-rest keys if any stateful logs are retained.

Cc'ing Karthik to loop in runtime/tracing design — Karthik, can your team review their sample traces and advise if a pre-processing shim is needed on our side?

I can do the technical sync Thurs 12/4 10:00–10:45am PST. Vanessa — can you confirm availability and whether we should invite a PM from solutions engineering?

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, Priya Rao <priya@apexbridge.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-03T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ApexBridge proposal — LangChain / LlamaIndex adapter + tracing pilot

+1 on the spike; please include a simple end-to-end acceptance test that exercises a 512-token generation with caching enabled so we can validate both latency and correct attribution in traces.

Priya — for the sync we'll want to see three things:
1) A short README in the repo that shows how the adapter imports into LangChain/LlamaIndex (minimal example)
2) An explanation of the trace schema and how it maps to Redwood request-level metadata (session id, model variant, batch id) — if you can point to the relevant file in the GH repo that helps speed review
3) A staging access plan (who needs accounts, what scopes are required)

I've added Marissa from Partner Engineering — she'll drive the developer acceptance tests and the onboarding checklist. Diego, Karthik — please add any runtime constraints you want surfaced in the SOW.

I'll schedule the Thurs 12/4 10am PST sync and share a calendar invite + preliminary agenda.

- Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Keller <tom.keller@apexbridge.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@apexbridge.io>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-04T07:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ApexBridge proposal — LangChain / LlamaIndex adapter + tracing pilot

Thanks Vanessa — we'll have a tiny demo ready for the sync that shows the adapter wired into a LangChain chain with a LlamaIndex index call; the demo will also emit OTLP traces and include the Redwood headers. Repo is here: https://github.com/apexbridge/langchain-llindex-adapter (readme/walkthrough in the next push).

High-level timeline:
- Week 0 (dec 6): spike to validate trace envelope and staging access
- Weeks 1–4: adapter development + iterative validation against your acceptance tests
- Weeks 5–6: docs, sample app, and a joint demo for developer advocates

We can fill the SOC 2 section of the questionnaire this week. On procurement/legal — we'll need a short SOW and a mutual NDA if we are going to exchange any customer data for validation (sample traces are sanitized for now).

See you on Thu.
Tom Keller
VP Product, ApexBridge
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Priya Rao <priya@apexbridge.io>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@apexbridge.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-11T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ApexBridge proposal — LangChain / LlamaIndex adapter + tracing pilot

Following up after our sync — attached is a mutual action plan and a lightly edited SOW reflecting the spike and acceptance criteria we discussed. Key owners and next steps below (please reply inline if anything looks off):

Mutual action plan (short):
- Spike (week of Dec 13): ApexBridge to push trace snippet with Redwood headers to GH; Redwood runtime team to validate span mapping (owner: karthik_iyer) — target 12/17
- Dev iteration (weeks 1–4): ApexBridge implements adapter changes; Redwood provides acceptance test feedback and perf numbers (owner: marissa_cole) — target demo 1/14
- Docs & handoff (weeks 5–6): joint guide, sample app, and onboarding checklist (owner: vanessa_ortiz) — target 1/28

Attachments: ApexBridge_SOW_v0.2.pdf (redwood edits), ApexBridge_security_questionnaire.xlsx (redwood notes)

Procurement/legal: Diego to loop Legal if we need a short mutual NDA or data processing addendum — please flag if you have redlines on the SOW content.

If everything looks good, I'll ask Marissa to open a staging project and invite the ApexBridge service account.

Thanks all — excited to get this moving.

Diego Fernandez
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
